summary: 5:30 PM ET run, published at 6:04 ET. Settled from ESPN box scores: Eagles at Titans over 39.5 at BetMGM -108 won (44 points); Panthers at Falcons over 43.5 at ESPN BET -105 lost (37 points), which also loses the five-leg longshot on its first leg, a quarter unit. Model leans are 1-1 with three totals and three props still in play. Nothing closed. Browns at Buccaneers is in a weather delay, the storm the morning run passed on. No evening pick yet: Colts at Chiefs is priced but nothing on it clears the bar.

gamePicks.title: Panthers at Falcons over 43.5
gamePicks.quoteNote: ESPN BET's price from the 8:37 AM ET capture across five books, the best number and price on the board for this side.
gamePicks.edge: v2 total 45.8 (80% range 29.4 to 62.1). Chance of over 43.5: 52.9% (v2's raw 57.0% shrunk by its 2024-25 record against the close), against 51.2% break-even at -105: +1.7 points, +0.033u per unit.
gamePicks.cutoff: OVER 43.5 at -105 or better. Closed to new entries at 45+, or at -120 or worse at 43.5.
gamePicks.why: Settled from the ESPN box score. Carolina scored 34 and Atlanta, starting Cooper Rush, managed 3; the game fell six and a half points short of the total.
gamePicks.risk: The published risk held: one game of history for both teams, and a market that knew more than the model.

gamePicks.cutoff: OVER 39.5 at -108 or better. Closed to new entries at 41+, or at -123 or worse at 39.5.

gamePicks.risk: One result on a thin sample; the model earns its record over a season, not an afternoon.

parlays.title: Sunday five-leg totals longshot, +2527
parlays.quoteNote: Each leg's price is BetMGM's from the latest capture; the combined price is the book's parlay arithmetic, decimal 26.265.
parlays.edge: Our chance 4.3%, the product of the legs' calibrated chances (54.3, 53.2, 53.1, 52.9, 52.9%), against 3.8% break-even at +2527: +0.127u per unit staked, on a quarter unit. The miss rate is about 96%.
parlays.cutoff: All 5 legs at BetMGM at these numbers (43.5, 51, 39.5, 43.5, 41), +2527 or better combined. Pass if any leg's number moves off or the combined price falls under +2000.
parlays.why: Settled from the ESPN box score of the leg that lost; a parlay with a lost leg is lost whatever the other legs do.
parlays.risk: A five-leg ticket at 4% on our own numbers; this is the expected outcome and the stake was a quarter unit.
parlays.correlation: Five different games, so the legs are independent on our view and the price is the book's product of the legs. One leg is also today's model lean straight pick.
parlays.actual: Lost on the first leg: Panthers at Falcons finished 34-3, 37 points, under 43.5. The other four legs were still in play when it settled.
